title: Help me understand act structure with examples

commenti.body:
Act 1 - expostion

Act 2 - escalation

Act 3 - climax and resolution

If you want to use Kurosawa's Yojimbo as an example: In Act 1 Sanjuro comes into town and the learns about the town's warring gangs and violence from the restaurant owner. In Act 2 Sanjuro starts infiltrating both clans and playing them off of eachother. Unosuke reveals he has a pistol. Sanjuro helps free the farmer's wife. The fighting escalates. The silk shop and brewery are burned. And Sanjuro is found to be double crossing and is captured and beaten. In Act 3 Sanjuro escapes, the big showdown in the center of town occurs, Sanjuro defeats Unosuke and the gang and leaves town.
